verdict.rationale: The API partitions files into structured, typed document elements with metadata. Its Auto strategy routes each page to Fast, High Res, or VLM partitioning, and generative OCR and table-to-HTML enrichments improve fidelity, which together imply real handling of complex PDFs such as annual reports. None of the evidence specifically addresses multi-column reading order, header/footer detection or footnote handling, and there is no independent or hands-on accuracy evidence. Missing for 10: documented multi-column reading-order handling, explicit header/footer/footnote element detection, independent or hands-on accuracy corroboration on complex PDFs.
